comment: The worst out of all the classes I took this semester

Honestly, Dr. Becker isn't the best teacher but it is very easy to get an A in this class. There are weekly papers, but they are 250 words and barely anything. Class is boring and lectures can feel long, but the easy A is worth taking the class in my opinion.

The Poetry & Music class was all basically poetry. Falsely advertised to involve more music. Not much class discussion, and the teacher wasn't always listening to the class. If you like poetry and lots of analyzing, go for it. He's gonna make u write a 500 word paper analyzing a different poem each week.

He's understanding and answers emails well. However, his poetry and music FYS has tons of reading and writing. It's a lot easier if you don't overthink it. We really didn't have many meaningful discussions about the poems during class.

Becker is an extremely talented piano player and poet. His teaching flaw is that he firmly sticks to his ideas on the poems discussed in class. He is looking for any answers from students to match precisely what he believes to be true. He loves to claim that there is no wrong answer but then shuts students down when they try to contribute.

I had Dr. Becker for Poetry and Music FYS and the class was decent. Every day you analyze a new poem and have group discussions. There was no homework except for a 250 Word close reading analysis every Friday. He is very quirky and sometimes boring but the class was very easy compared to the other seminars. If you miss a class, you don't miss much

Made me sure that I wanted nothing to do with the Music Department at UR. Just thinking about going to my lesson gave me panic attacks. Our personalities clashed, and practicingperforming was a teeth-grinding experience. Ruined any joy I ever got out of playing music on a personal level. His teaching style was not my cup of tea, but good luck.
a nice person,, passionate about music. dont take him in core. ....boring, dry and a tough grader

Dr. Becker is an enthusiastic piano professor. He helps me to He is very hard piano teacher, but he truly wants his students to put works into practicing and gain from it. I've gained so much more insights about piano and Dr. Becker makes me more appreciate piano and music. He is the best piano professor I've ever had. I definitely recommend him.

He's a great piano teacher and a remarkable pianist himself. Although he can be very hard on his piano students, he understands where each student is individually coming from. He has very effective ways of helping his students understand the music and perform it better. I would recommend him as a piano teacher.

I found him disgusting both as a person and as a teacher. I guess he is weird and you have to understand his weirdness in order to like him. Extremely unclear, unfair, partial and out-of-topic. However, he did a good job in terms of bringing papers back in time. Overall, bad quality!
